text:
Have you heard

at night

the bear-horse cry


oo—oo—oo—oo


or the coyote

alone in the night

of moonlight


uuuuuuuuuuuuuú?


well that is exactly

what these verses are.

translation.title: Have You Heard?
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the animal cries and lets the poem define itself as that same nocturnal sound.
